comment: GitHub #150, since 0.2.0-dev.31.18: the skill tree's paid reset (resetAllSkills) and a node's unlearn count and pay their respec item (Runes, the payer's own constant 0x41a792dc) from a player's crafting sources linked with CraftSourceOptions.Respec. player_skilltree (S 0xd4780, C 0x2e87e0) runs the version-checked UnlockSkillAction: unlearn (S 0xbbab0, C 0x2cfb10) pays the node's cost and undoes the NodeSet when the payment fails; reset (skills/Reset, S 0xb9a00, C 0x2ce370) pays the points spent when its pay flag is set, and the join check's reset (S 0xd48a7, C 0x2e8907) passes 0 and never reaches the payer. Both pay through respec/Payer (S 0xb9230, C 0x2cdce0): cost 0 answers 1 (paid) at once; else an inventory transaction from a setup with stock mode 2 (the player's bag, then the Magic chests of the base the player stands in, BaseStockForPlayer), one cost line {item respec/item, count = cost} and rules/InventoryPay(tx, {line, 1}, player, 1, 0): 0 commits (paid), anything else rolls back (refused). respec/RespecPaid is that call's return address: kiln.rules' InventoryPay hook hands it to kiln-items' craft adapter, which pays the rest from the player's respec-opted links inside the same transaction (bag and Magic chests first, all or nothing). Identical bytes on server 26430253 (f0d824be) and client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1). Evidence: docs/re/respec.md.

respec/Payer.comment: The respec payer's entry: movzx ebx,dx (the cost); test bx,bx; jne; mov al,1 (cost 0: paid, nothing asked); then the setup's flags 0 and stock mode 2 (mov word [rsp+0x60],0x200). kiln-items checks this range for another module's code before it pays from links. Server 26430253 0xb9230, client 26430625 0x2cdce0

respec/RespecPaid.comment: The respec payer's payment: mov [rsp+0x54],ebx (the cost); mov [rsp+0x50],respec/item; call (the player: world/CurrentEntityId); {ptr rsp+0x40, count 1} at rsp+0x30 (one 24-byte cost line: item +0x10, count +0x14); lea rcx,[rbp+0x50] (the transaction); mov [rsp+0x20],rsi (no item override); mov r8d,[rax] (the player); mov r9d,1; call rules/InventoryPay; then test eax,eax; je commit, else rollback (bl 0). The return address, which kiln-items compares with the payment hook's caller (its call target is checked against rules/InventoryPay, call_matches). Server 26430253 0xb93c3, client 26430625 0x2cde73

respec/item.comment: The respec item the payer charges (Material_T1_Token_WeaponUpgrade_Rune01, Runes): 0x41a792dc on both builds
